restaurantName: Afternoon Tea at Holiday Inn Birmingham City Centre
bio: Escape the hustle and bustle of Birmingham's city centre and treat yourself and a loved one to an Afternoon Tea at The Holiday Inn Birmingham City Centre. Nestled inside The in-house restaurant is a stylish, round-the-clock hangout where everyone will feel at home.  With a modern interior and a friendly, laid-back atmosphere, The Holiday Inn Birmingham City Centre provides guests with a relaxed dining experience in a chic, contemporary setting.  The Holiday Inn Birmingham City Centre is just a stone's throw from New Street Train Station.
pageTitle: Afternoon Tea at Holiday Inn Birmingham City Centre
